patch.value: Measure evaluation sensitivity to declared training slices

Run explicitly budgeted omission and integer reweighting experiments for declared training slices; retain exact checkpoints and measured per-evaluation associations, and carry bounded evidence into the next proposal.

Reports reproduce on a fixed learner and seed; Held-out data never enters training; Exhausted experiment budgets return partial evidence without a ranking claim; Typed SDK and compact CLI output, audit records, recursive proposal evidence, non-git public-copy validation, seeded model tests and npm plus Bun release gates

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap rechecked against current core CLI/SDK, pm-rl policy-card.ts and evaluation-plan.ts, and pm-jev counterfactual.ts. Core owns native records/history/locks; policy cards explain provenance and validity; Jev removes inference evidence. This feature measures retraining sensitivity. Preserve all normal proposal, evaluation, promotion and feedback gates. Results remain associations; no causal identification claim. Current published CLI is 2026.10.28; package SDK remains pinned 2026.10.25.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented the first typed request/report schema and fixed seeded retraining using the existing bandit kernel. Integer multiplicities implement omissions/reweighting; exact integer budgets include the baseline. Numerical tests confirm deterministic checkpoints, changed held-out scores without changed fitted parameters, strict dense/finite admission, and partial evidence with ranking=null. Native report identity is immutable; proposal evidence cites a certified SDK history revision and is retained in seed/candidate provenance. No shared experiment budget, plan replay or new promotion authority is introduced.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Installed-host root cause established with real SDK/CLI reads: the pinned SDK emits compact history oldest-first, while CLI 2026.10.28 emits newest-first. The old last-row lookup selected revision 1 after a peer had retyped revision 2. This is a package presentation-order assumption, not an upstream defect claim. Removed the assumption in every compact-history consumer: influence latest reads choose the greatest durable coordinate; policy citations and promotion attribution choose the earliest qualifying durable coordinate through one validated ordering function. A 500-permutation property test uses actual native history rows, rejects invalid/repeated coordinates, verifies fixed read-back, and injects a real retype after historical capture. Explicit historical citations remain usable; current reads revalidate current ownership separately.
